detail.title: KM540 Gaming Keyboard & Mouse Combo - Black
detail.overview: The Ant Esports KM540 pairs a rainbow backlit LED keyboard with a programmable optical mouse in a combo built from premium-grade plastic, with a textured metallic top plate that resists warping over time. Double-shot ABS keycaps sit on membrane switches with 7 pre-set lighting patterns and 3 brightness levels, evenly diffused through a polymer layer for comfortable use in dark rooms. A built-in wrist rest and rubberized feet add comfort and stability during long gaming or typing sessions, while the mouse offers 4 adjustable DPI levels (800-3200) for smooth, accurate tracking across different tasks. Broad compatibility spans Windows 2000 through Windows 10 and Mac OS, making it a dependable everyday combo for PC, laptop and Mac users.
